An explicit binomial polynomial H_a,b gives residue(-1)^a*(H(S,V)/V^m-H(2-S,W)/W^m). The primitive equation F_a,b=[t^m H(1+V(1-t),V)-H(1-V(1-t),tV)]/(t-1) has exact V-degreea-1 and content1 overC[t]. Explicit first-two-coefficient root-of-unity values exclude every omitted vertical component. The involution(t,V)->(1/t,tV) forgets first-pair ordering; equal-profile color exchange is taken only after both pair orderings are quotiented. By exchanginga,b the residual degree ismin(a,b)-1.

declarations.name: Theorem W2. Uniform geometric irreducibility when \(a=3\)
declarations.scope: For everyb>=3, F_3,b is geometrically irreducible. Its explicit quadratic coefficients r0,r1,r2 have discriminant D(0)=0,D'(0)=2b^2(b+1) !=0 after removal of(t-1)^2. The simple t0 zero proves nonsquareness overC(t); Gauss's lemma and the content proof give plane geometric irreducibility. The collision boundary is used only for valuation.
